visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long wavy light brown hair and prominent makeup stands in a brightly lit studio set. She is wearing a low-cut, long-sleeved beige ribbed dress that exposes her shoulders. Her facial expression is initially worried and anxious as she looks off-camera. The background is a colorful interior set with various shelves, neon signs, and graphic panels. (2) The camera zooms in for a medium close-up of the woman's face as she begins to cry. Realistic tears are visible streaming down her cheeks, and her eyes appear red. She looks around the studio frantically, her mouth trembling as she speaks. The colorful studio background remains visible but blurred in the shallow depth of field. (3) The woman becomes more animated, yelling while gesturing slightly with her hands. She moves through the studio space, eventually standing in front of a black curtain area. Her expression remains one of exaggerated distress and desperation. She holds a blue smartphone and some papers in one hand while continuing to look for someone. (4) The scene cuts abruptly to a man with short black hair sitting on a toilet in a beige-tiled bathroom. He is wearing a blue Adidas hoodie and has his arms crossed over his stomach. His face is contorted in a grimace of extreme physical strain and discomfort, his eyes squinted shut as he appears to be struggling with a bowel movement.
